$comment: Reconciliation manifest for the local CI gate. Read by scripts/check-ci-drift.mjs.
One entry per step in .github/workflows, keyed by '<workflow>::<job>::<step name>'.
hash   - content hash of the step (run/uses + with + env + if) when it was last
reconciled. The guard recomputes it; a mismatch fails the gate.
mirror - the local command asserted to cover this step, or null when exempt.
reason - why the mirror covers it, or why it cannot run locally. Required.
IMPORTANT: `mirror` is a HUMAN ASSERTION, not something the guard verifies. The
guard's job is to make sure that assertion is re-made whenever the CI step changes,
so the local gate cannot drift out of sync in silence. When a hash mismatch sends
you here, actually re-read the workflow step before bumping the hash.

docs-archive.yml::changes::Checkout clas.reason: GitHub-only: checks out the classifier script (scripts/ci-changed-paths.mjs) from the pull request's base commit into base-ref/ rather than its own merge commit. This pins the classifier's SOURCE so an accidental or careless edit (a rename, a bad rebase) cannot silently change it — it is NOT a defense against a pull request that deliberately tries to bypass its own gates, since the `changes` job's YAML itself (including the invocation step) is read from the pull request's merge commit the same as everything else in this workflow; see #1022 for the honest framing and why that residual exposure is accepted. Locally the working tree already is the code under test, and there is no PR base/head distinction to reproduce.

docs-archive.yml::changes::Setup Node.reason: GitHub-only Node setup for PR gating. This repository's local checks already assume Node is available locally for scripts and format/lint tooling.

docs-archive.yml::changes::Check whether.reason: The step now inlines the fallback directly (round-3 review fix: replaced a separate PR-controlled wrapper script with a few lines of shell, since a separate file has no different trust level than inline YAML content — both are read from the pull request's merge commit): if base-ref/scripts/ci-changed-paths.mjs exists, run it and pass its output/exit code straight through; otherwise print a loud [MISSING BASE CLASSIFIER] warning and resolve relevant=true, on a code path that never invokes the classifier. scripts/ci-gate-bootstrap.test.mjs parses this exact `run:` block from the real workflow file (not a restatement) and executes it directly against both cases for all four workflows. The classifier's own decision logic (including the 3,000-file API-ceiling fail-closed check) remains covered by ci-changed-paths.test.mjs. The live gh api calls remain GitHub-only and unmirrored.

docs-archive.yml::docs-archive::Check ar.reason: Run locally to catch archive-record body drift and header/provenance issues before docs-only reviews land. Link checks inside docs/archive are intentionally skipped, per docs/README.md's archive policy.

docs-archive.yml::gate::Check required j.reason: GitHub-only: this is the #1017 aggregate required-check step, which reads the needs context (via toJSON(needs)) across the workflow's other jobs. Round-3 review fix: fails closed on an empty needs set and on any result value outside GitHub's documented success/skipped (the only two passing values) — not just failure/cancelled — since a valid-but-wrong shape (empty object/array, missing .result, an unrecognized value) previously passed silently after examining nothing. scripts/ci-gate-aggregation.test.mjs extracts and executes this exact run: body (parsed from the real workflow, not restated) against every documented result combination plus every fail-open shape a reviewer found. That context only exists inside a GitHub Actions run, so this step itself stays GitHub-only/unmirrored locally.

front-e2e.yml::test::Wait for front stac.reason: ci-e2e-front uses 'docker compose up --wait --wait-timeout 180' instead of the workflow's hand-rolled docker inspect polling loop. Same property (every service running and healthy before Playwright starts, 180s budget), enforced by compose itself rather than by bash.

front-e2e.yml::test::Cache Playwright br.reason: GitHub-only actions/cache step; the local recipe has no separate browser-cache action or equivalent cache backend.

front-e2e.yml::test::Run playwright brow.reason: ci-e2e-front runs the same complete Playwright suite on one isolated local stack. CI partitions the non-counter projects across four isolated runners and runs the counter project alone after setup on shard 4, now followed by chromium-hermetic-source (#973 round-3 review BLOCKER: this hermetic project previously ran locally via the unsharded `playwright test` but was never selected by any CI shard); the local gate stays unsharded to preserve coverage without multiplying Docker stacks. It also drops --with-deps, which requires root; system libraries are a one-time developer setup.

front-e2e.yml::test::Upload playwright r.reason: actions/upload-artifact uses a shard-specific name to get each report off its ephemeral runner. Locally the report is already on disk at apps/front/playwright-report; there is nothing to upload it to.

front-e2e.yml::test::Tear down front sta.reason: ci-e2e-front runs the identical docker compose ... down -v as its final step. DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE: this workflow step is if:always(), which a justfile cannot express (just stops at the first failing line), so the recipe also resets the stack with down -v --remove-orphans before bringing it up. Net effect is the same clean slate per run; a failed run's stack is left up locally for inspection instead.

openapi-spec-drift.yml::spec-drift::Mate.reason: CI-only compensation for the gitignored, absent .env.development. Copies .env.example, then forces APP_ROLE=api so build-time OpenAPI doc-gen runs api-only (no worker WorkerMigrationStartupGate, no DB connection) -- .env.example ships APP_ROLE=all. Since #1019, DotNetEnv.LoadOptions.NoClobber() already makes the just recipe's own APP_ROLE=api export win over that file value, so this sed is defense in depth rather than load-bearing; it stays because a regression in that precedence would otherwise hang the DB-less runner. Locally a developer already has a real repo-root .env.development, so just ci-spec-drift needs no such step.
